wall_seeps_1.subject: only the glossy honey-gold amber itself, no stone and no wall drawn behind it: a thick wet ribbon of amber that starts as a thin crack-shaped seam at the top and runs down in three slow tongues of different length, the longest ending in a heavy drop

wall_seeps_2.subject: only the glossy honey-gold amber itself, no stone and no wall drawn behind it: a broad slow sheet of amber that is thin and ragged at the top and pools thick at the bottom with three short drips hanging from its lower edge

wall_seeps_3.subject: only the glossy honey-gold amber itself, no stone and no wall drawn behind it: one single long thin tear of amber running straight down with a small round bead caught at its end

wall_seeps_4.subject: only the glossy honey-gold amber itself, no stone and no wall drawn behind it: a loose scatter of small beads and drops of amber, some joined by thin glossy threads

floor_temple_1.subject: a patch of pale blue-white frost rime, delicate crystal ferns spreading out in all directions from a cold centre with soft ragged edges

floor_temple_2.subject: a curved arc of thin inlaid gold line set into black stone, a quarter of a circle with a small engraved diamond at its middle, worn and a little dull

floor_temple_3.subject: a set of four long parallel scrape marks gouged across stone, where something heavy was dragged, pale scratched grooves with grit

floor_temple_4.subject: a drift of fine white frost dust and a few tiny ice crystals scattered unevenly with soft edges
